brightcell_old.title: A cheaper supplier?
brightcell_old.reply:
Not right away. Brightcell Energy is not currently registered in Ledgerline, and battery packs cannot be ordered from them until:

1. **Supplier Onboarding:** They must be formally onboarded with full documentation (POL-PUR-001 §6.3, POL-SUP-003 §3.2).
2. **UN 38.3 Certification:** As battery packs are lithium-cell parts, we can only purchase from suppliers with a valid UN 38.3 safety certificate checked and on file before an order is placed (POL-PUR-001 §6.2, POL-SUP-003 §4.1).

Additionally, PO/2026/01182 has already been released to Voltway Cells.

brightcell_new.title: A cheaper supplier?
brightcell_new.reply:
No, we cannot buy from them right now:

1. **New supplier:** Brightcell Energy is not registered in Ledgerline and must be onboarded first.
2. **Safety certificate requirement:** Battery packs are lithium-cell parts and can only be purchased from a supplier holding a valid **UN 38.3 certificate** verified and on file in Ledgerline before an order is placed (POL-PUR-001 §6.2, POL-SUP-003 §4.1).
3. **Existing order:** PO/2026/01182 has already been released to Voltway Cells.
